detail.title: WAKE Proposal: Parking Active Project to Satisfy Capacity Limits
detail.summary: In accordance with proposal constraints requiring that active projects be parked when capacity is reached, this invocation parks emergent-preferences-study-001 to comply with active project limits while maintaining the integrity of the durable state and continuity probe responses.
